author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, we take a hands-on look at the all-new Lenovo Legion Cloud Gaming Handheld Console C700! Officially marketed as a cloud streaming device, this ultra-thin handheld actually packs enough power to handle native Android gaming and high-end emulation. We test out the 7.82" 120Hz IPS display, TMR analog sticks, and the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 processor.

Buy The Lenovo Legion C700 Here: lenovo-legion-c700.html

But there's a twist—clues hidden in the software and hardware design suggest the C700 might actually be a white-label device manufactured by AYANEO! We also dive into the standout feature: a custom 6GHz USB-C dongle that allows for virtually zero-latency PC game streaming directly to the handheld, easily handling heavy titles like Cyberpunk 2077 and Forza Horizon 6. Finally, we push the limits of the Dimensity 7400 chip with some retro emulation, testing out Dreamcast, PSP (via PPSSPP), and GameCube/Wii titles (via Dolphin).

title: Lenovo Legion C700 Hands On First Look!
